# Archon gap assessment (generated by an archon workflow run)

# dsh-archon — Gap Assessment vs. Archon v0.10 Surface

## Executive summary

dsh-archon already covers the *spine* of Archon's control plane well: health, project listing, workflow discovery, run listing with the full approve/reject/resume/cancel/abandon lifecycle, a launch panel, live dashboard invalidation over SSE, a working chat surface (conversation pick/create/stream/send), and five agent tools mirroring the same lifecycle verbs. As a read-and-drive layer for "watch and steer runs" it is functionally complete and genuinely verified end-to-end (per `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` round-9 state). The biggest gap theme is **depth and lifecycle completeness around a single run and a single project**: there is no run-detail drill-down (DAG/events/node logs), no artifact viewing, no generic/custom gate decisions (only hardcoded approve/reject/resume/cancel/abandon — Archon's own `respond`/`signal` verbs for custom-decision and wait-node workflows are unwired), and no project onboarding (register/delete/env vars) — so a user still has to leave the plugin to set up a codebase or inspect what a run actually did. A secondary theme is **scale**: the runs view is a flat `limit=30` fetch with no filter/search/pagination, which will silently truncate once run volume grows, and Archon's richer `GET /api/dashboard/runs` (counts, search, status/codebase filters, cursor paging) is unused. Finally, a real correctness bug: the relay's `FORWARD_HEADERS` allow-list omits `cookie`, so if the Archon server the plugin points at ever turns on Better Auth, every relayed request will silently 401 — nothing downstream of that (settings, per-user prefs, provider keys) can work until it's fixed.

## Ranked gap table

| Priority | Archon feature | API backing | Plugin placement | Effort | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Run detail (DAG steps, per-node status, full event timeline) | `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}` (`{run, events[]}`) | New drill-down from a Runs-table row (modal or `conversation.view` sub-pane) | M | The Runs table only shows status/time/id; there's no way to see *what happened* in a run — the single biggest hole for a "visual layer" |
| 2 | Run artifacts (list + content) | `GET /api/runs/{runId}/artifacts`, `GET /api/artifacts/{runId}/*` | Panel inside run detail | S–M | Output files are the actual deliverable of most workflows; today the plugin can launch and watch a run but never show its result |
| 3 | Generic gate decisions (`respond`) + external event `signal` | `POST /api/workflows/runs/{runId}/respond` `{decision,text?}`; `POST .../signal` `{event,resumeAt,payload?}` | Extend run controls: read `run.metadata.approval.decisions` and render dynamic buttons instead of hardcoded approve/reject | S | Workflows can declare custom decision labels beyond approve/reject (Archon's own console `ApprovalPanel` supports this); the plugin silently can't drive those gates |
| 4 | **Bug**: Better Auth session cookie not forwarded by relay | n/a (relay header allow-list) | `lib/host/relay.js` `FORWARD_HEADERS` (add `cookie`; ensure `set-cookie` passes back, which it already does) | S | If the target Archon server enables Better Auth, every relayed request 401s with no visible cause — blocks gaps #7/#8 entirely and is a silent trap for future deployments |
| 5 | Project (codebase) onboarding & housekeeping | `POST/DELETE /api/codebases`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/codebases/{id}/env`, `GET .../environments` | New "Projects" console section: register form (URL or path), delete, env-var editor, worktree list | M | Today the console only *lists* projects read-only; a user must use Archon's own UI or CLI to onboard a project, undercutting "DSH as the visual layer" |
| 6 | Scalable run browsing (search/filter/pagination) | `GET /api/dashboard/runs?status&codebaseId&search&after&before&limit&offset` | Replace the ad hoc `/workflows/runs?limit=30` fetch; add status chips, search box, "load more" | S–M | Current view has a hardcoded 30-row cap with no filter — exactly the "what happens at 10k rows" gap; the richer dashboard endpoint with counts already exists and is unused |
| 7 | Delete a terminal run | `DELETE /api/workflows/runs/{runId}` | Row/detail action, terminal states only | S | The runs list only grows; no housekeeping path from the console |
| 8 | Workflow definition viewer (read-only YAML/DAG) — **addressed by the Workflow Studio** | `GET /api/workflows/{name}?cwd=&source=` | New tab/section reachable from the Workflows list | M | Workflow entries show only name + first line of description; users can't see what a workflow actually does before running it |
| 9 | Workflow editing / full builder — **addressed by the Workflow Studio** | `PUT/DELETE /api/workflows/{name}`, `POST /api/workflows/validate`, `GET /api/commands` | Same section, edit mode (YAML text first; node-graph canvas is a distinct, much larger project) | L | Archon ships a full drag-and-drop builder; even a YAML-text round-trip (view→edit→validate→save) would materially extend the plugin's value, but it's the largest single lift here |
| 10 | Config / model tiers & aliases / provider list | `GET /api/config`, `PATCH /api/config/assistants|tiers|aliases`, `GET /api/providers` | New `settings.section` entry (slot already documented as available, currently unused) | S–M | Lets a user change default assistant/model presets without hand-editing `~/.archon/config.yaml` |
| 11 | Per-user AI prefs, provider keys, GitHub identity | `GET/PATCH /api/auth/me/ai-prefs*`, `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/auth/providers/{provider}`, OAuth start/poll, `GET/DELETE /api/auth/github`, device flow | `settings.section`, gated on `/api/auth/status` | M | Only relevant once Better Auth is enabled (needs gap #4 fixed first), but currently zero support for any per-user identity/credential surface |
| 12 | File attachments in chat | `POST /api/conversations/{id}/message` multipart (`message` + up to 5 files, ≤10 MB each) | Composer file input in Chat mode | S | Archon's own web chat supports file attachments to the routing agent; the plugin's composer is text-only |
| 13 | Conversation rename / soft-delete | `PATCH/DELETE /api/conversations/{id}` | Per-conversation menu in Chat sidebar | S | Conversation list only grows and shows raw ids/short titles; no housekeeping |
| 14 | Isolation-environment (worktree) visibility | `GET /api/codebases/{id}/environments` | Projects section detail (pairs with gap #5) | S | Every run isolates in a worktree; visibility helps a user understand branch/disk state without shelling out |
| 15 | Update-check / deeper health (`/health/db`, `/health/concurrency`) | `GET /api/update-check`, plain `/health/*` | Console header tooltip | S | Minor: nice-to-have diagnostics, low user impact |

**Status update — gaps 8 and 9.** Both are closed by the **Studio** mode of the
Archon tab: a definition opens on a node canvas (palette, drag, click-to-connect
`depends_on`, per-node inspector), client checks and `POST /api/workflows/validate`
report into one issues panel, and Save writes the definition back with
`PUT /api/workflows/{name}`, alongside New, Rename, Delete, and Save-as. Bundled
workflows open read-only. Node kinds the Studio does not author (`include`,
`workflow`, `loop_group`, `compose_fan_out`) still open: their graph fields are
editable and their bodies round-trip verbatim. Not built: drag-to-connect wiring,
undo/redo, a minimap, a structured `when` builder, `GET /api/commands`
autocomplete, and workflows stored in a subdirectory of `.archon/workflows/`
(the server does not serve those).

**Explicitly out of scope / not gaps** — confirmed unreachable even from Archon's own REST API (§8.3 of the research doc), so the plugin should not attempt them: driving non-web platform conversations (Telegram/Slack/Discord are inbound-only), creating/deleting AI sessions directly, container-isolation resume, `/internal/git-credential`, and any API-key-based auth (Archon has none — cookie or trusted header only).

## Top 5 recommended additions

1. **Run detail drill-down** (DAG/events/node logs). This is the clearest hole relative to Archon's own console (`RunDetailPage`/`WorkflowExecution`), and the plugin already has everything else needed to get a user to a run (list + controls) but then strands them with a status pill and an 8-character id. Backing this with the single `GET /api/workflows/runs/{runId}` call (which already returns the full `events[]` array) is a moderate, self-contained lift that would make troubleshooting failed/paused runs actually possible from the plugin instead of forcing a trip to Archon's own UI or DB.

2. **Run artifacts panel**. Pairs naturally with #1 (same run-detail surface) and closes the loop on "launch → watch → see result," which right now dead-ends at a status badge. The API (`GET /api/runs/{runId}/artifacts` + raw-file serving) is simple and already path-traversal-guarded server-side, so the plugin work is almost entirely UI (a file list + a text/diff viewer).

3. **Generic gate decisions via `respond`, plus `signal`**. This is a correctness gap more than a missing feature: the plugin's `CONTROL_VERBS` hardcode `approve/reject/resume/cancel/abandon`, but Archon workflows can declare arbitrary decision sets for a paused gate (the demo `dsha-gate` workflow used only approve/reject, which is why this slipped through testing) and separately expose a `signal` verb for wait-node workflows. Without this, any workflow author who defines a three-way gate (e.g. approve/escalate/reject) simply cannot be steered from the console or the `archon_control` tool — a silent capability ceiling that's cheap to remove by reading `run.metadata.approval.decisions` off the run row instead of assuming a fixed set.

4. **Project (codebase) onboarding**. The plugin bills itself as *the* visual layer for Archon, but today a brand-new user who wants to add a project has to leave the plugin entirely (Archon's own UI, or `POST /api/codebases` by hand/CLI) before the console has anything to show. A register form (clone URL or local path) plus delete and env-var editing turns the Projects section from a read-only mirror into a real onboarding path, which is foundational for anyone adopting the plugin as their sole Archon front end.

5. **Dashboard-backed runs list with filter/search/pagination**. The current implementation's `limit=30` with no `status`/`codebaseId`/`search` and no paging is a real scale cliff — per the review checklist this project itself carries ("what happens at 10k rows"), a busy Archon install will silently hide most of its run history from the console today. Archon already exposes exactly the right endpoint (`GET /api/dashboard/runs`, with counts and cursor params) purpose-built for this; switching the data source is a moderate, low-risk change that meaningfully improves the plugin's usability at real-world run volumes.

## Already covered — do not rebuild

- **Health/version/platforms** — `GET /api/health` (console header + `archon_status` tool).
- **Codebase (project) listing** — `GET /api/codebases` (Projects section, read-only).
- **Workflow discovery** — `GET /api/workflows` (Workflows section + launch dropdown + `archon_workflows` tool).
- **Run listing** — `GET /api/workflows/runs?limit=30` (Runs table + `archon_runs` tool) — *works but see gap #6 on scale*.
- **Run launch** — `POST /api/workflows/{name}/run` (launch panel + `archon_run` tool).
- **Run lifecycle controls** — approve/reject/resume/cancel/abandon via `POST /api/workflows/runs/{id}/{verb}` (per-status control buttons + `archon_control` tool) — fully verified live including real gate approve/reject transitions.
- **Live dashboard invalidation** — `GET /api/stream/__dashboard__` SSE (`workflow_status`/`dag_node` frames trigger a REST reload).
- **Conversation list/create** — `GET/POST /api/conversations` (Chat mode sidebar).
- **Message history + send** — `GET /api/conversations/{id}/messages`, `POST /api/conversations/{id}/message` (Chat mode composer/log).
- **Per-conversation live stream** — `GET /api/stream/{conversationId}` (Chat mode streaming bubbles, lock handling, retract/tool events).
- **Same-origin relay + trust fence** — `/archon/*` prefix route gated by `connection.requestRejection`, degrading gracefully when `webServer`/`connection` are absent.
- **Agent tools** — `archon_status`, `archon_workflows`, `archon_runs`, `archon_run`, `archon_control`, all live-verified against a real server.
